Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and Financial Statements, granting full discharge of responsibility to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for their management and supervision.
Agenda #2: Shareholders decided not to distribute dividends or allocate reserve funds, opting to use the entire net profit to reduce accumulated losses from previous years.
Agenda #3: Tanubrata Sutanto Fahmi Bambang and Rekan (BDO International) was appointed to audit the company's books for the 2026 fiscal year.
Agenda #4: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners to determine the 2026 remuneration, bonuses, and facilities for the Board and Directors with a maximum increase of 1.5%.
Agenda #5: The Board of Directors received a one-year authorization to pledge or transfer company assets as collateral for financial facilities, including debt securities or refinancing.
Agenda #6: Article 3 of the Articles of Association was adjusted to align with the 2025 Standard Classification of Indonesian Business Fields (KBLI) and risk-based licensing regulations.
